children: The Reserve Bank of India will hold a longer-term cash withdrawal auction with an early redemption feature to encourage banks to deploy surplus funds and manage rising liquidity.
The RBI will conduct a 30-day variable rate reverse repo for 7 trillion rupees  ($74.09 billion) on September 7, it said on Friday.
